name: Haggle
tagline: Practise salary negotiation against an AI with a hidden budget while your phone camera reads your stress.
problem: Most people never negotiate salary, and those who do often crack under pressure.
solution: An AI negotiator trained on negotiation literature holds a hidden budget; the phone camera estimates heart rate and breathing to show when you are cracking.
demo_moment: Team-described: negotiate live and see a stress spike when you concede.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Third Overall Software Hack” among 176 submissions.

lessons: A second signal (the body) makes practice feel real.
